steps.name: The Star Dwarf's Request
steps.objective: Talk to [Elphie] at the entrance to the "Silver Branch Mansion", then find [Taffy] inside.

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Poh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a peculiar-looking person. No... Perhaps not a person at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eyes gleam from within the blackness...)

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Hello. Are you an adventurer, by any chance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You nod and introduce yourself.)

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Oh... I see. You look quite capable!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Elphie, gatekeeper of the Silver Branch Mansion!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Meeting a skilled adventurer at a time like this is a stroke of luck!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: If you don't mind, would you visit our mansion and meet [Taffy], the [Star Knight]?

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: There's something we'd very much like to ask of you.

steps.name: Constellation Cliff
steps.objective: Talk to [Taffy] in the "Silver Branch Mansion", then defeat [Luceria] inside the "Constellation Cliff".

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Elphie said we had a visitor... I simply can't help wondering what sort of person they might be. (Curious)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Ah! An unfamiliar face! Taffy's feeling a little nervous! (Startled)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But you don't seem like a bad sort... (Pondering)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: In any case, a welcome is in order! Taffy's warm heart hopes for friendly relations! (Resolved)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: A pleasure, a pleasure! Welcome to <Lilir>, the Star Cradle! Hurrah! (Overjoyed)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: I am Taffy, a Star Knight who guards Lilir in keeping with the Keeper of the Stars' wishes! Leave anything to me! (Confident)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Though I can't quite shake the feeling that we'll be the ones asking for help... (Suddenly timid)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask about the favor Elphie mentioned...)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: My, my, Elphie is hasty! But I trust Elphie's judgment. The title of Silver Branch Mansion's gatekeeper isn't just for show! (Trusting)

lines.speaker: 가피
lines.text: How did we choose the gatekeeper again, poh?

lines.speaker: 다피
lines.text: Cockroach Poker, poh.

lines.speaker: 나피
lines.text: No, poh. Didn't we plant beans that day, poh...?

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Quiet, all of you! (Shouting)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Ahem. Back to the matter at hand. (Composed)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: The truth is, an intruder is roaming about Lilir... (Tense)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But we simply cannot determine exactly where they are or what they're doing! (Indignant)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Taffy... Taffy is ashamed! What an inadequate Star Dwarf I am, to call myself a Star Knight! (Ashamed)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Then, recently, we found a clue. We detected an enormous surge of magical power at Constellation Cliff. (Wary)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Yet whenever we try to approach, some strange magic leaves us lost before we know it... (Dejected)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Our marvelous, mysterious mages investigated. It seems the cliff is surrounded by a spell that bars fairies descended from spirits of the night. (Troubled)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: In other words, we Star Dwarfs and the Moon Elves, born of darkness spirits and moon spirits, cannot approach... Doesn't that reek of a vile conspiracy?! (Angry)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But now! A wanderer appears! An adventurer of great and mighty power! (Excited)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Surely this is the Keeper of the Stars' guidance! (Very excited)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Please, find out what is happening at Constellation Cliff! (Pleading)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...An intruder? You broke through my barrier?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: How tiresome. I had just reached the most important stage.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Come forth, Luceria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You sense a sinister magic. The shape of a girl begins to emerge from the mist.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Now, all the terror and pain, fear and hatred you've stored up over a hundred years... Every bit of it...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Unleash it upon them!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Oh...? Immature though Luceria may be, she is still a descendant of Walpurgis. Defeating her so easily is impressive.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Now that I look at you, aren't you the adventurers I met at my mansion? Forgive me... It has been some time. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She does seem somehow familiar, but you're certain you've never seen this girl before...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Hmm... You don't remember me?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Aha! You tried so hard to destroy me, and you've forgotten already?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Have you truly forgotten... me, [Pandora]?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora... The mistress of Poe Mansion, whom you fought while rescuing Levi Arens from the Gothic Room. Her appearance has changed completely...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask what you want to know...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ah, is this appearance why you didn't recognize me? As for why I look like this... Naturally, it's thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You nearly killed me in our fight at Poe Mansion. You could call this the result of losing most of my power.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And so I ended up in this body.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Though, for some reason, I feel as if I ought to thank you...?

choices.text: 2. Who was the girl we just fought?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That was Luceria. [Luceria the Beguiler]. Once, she was a promising witch.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The two of us were on such friendly terms that we tried to kill each other. Hehehe...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well, in truth, she was inexplicably obsessed with me. I merely dealt with her because I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Eventually I grew tired of it, so about a hundred years ago, I pulled out her soul and sealed it in a doll.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm sure she's having a wonderful time with the thousand magical beasts sealed in there with her.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ohoho...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm... How to explain? Shall we say I made a path for the immense currents of magic filling Lilir's <sky> to flow into its heart?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why did I do that? I can't tell you. I only did what I was asked...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...But it certainly wasn't some Agasura atrocity of the sort you're imagining.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If you insist on knowing more, why not ask the people who hired me?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You'll find them in the [Star Cradle], beneath Lilir's soil.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...There is one thing I ought to thank you for...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora seems to murmur something, but you cannot make it out...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...No, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If there's nothing more to discuss, I'll be going. Perhaps we'll meet again in the Star Cradle.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Until then—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora vanishes without warning...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Report what happened here to Taffy.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: So that's what happened... I now understand what took place at Constellation Cliff. Thank you for telling me! (Grateful)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: The Star Cradle... That lies at the heart of Lilir.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: It's a forbidden area, heavily guarded by Core Keepers. To think an intruder has entered...! (Shocked)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Adventurer! Please help us just a little longer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask what you want to know...)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: The Star Cradle... In the past, only the Keeper of the Stars was permitted to enter.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: They say the [Star's Heart] rests there, the source of the power of star creation that slumbers in Lilir! (Reverent)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: When Star Dwarfs grow old and reach the end of their lives, they return to the form of the darkness spirits from which they came... (Sorrowful)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But the Star Knights who vowed to guard Lilir can leave their will within their bodies, even after their lives have ended! (Astonished)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Those beings are the Star Keepers and Core Keepers. Even now, they wander the underground caverns, guarding the Star Cradle.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Only one thought remains in their minds: their duty to repel intruders! They cannot distinguish friend from foe. You must be careful!

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: The entrance to the Star Cradle is beneath this very place, the Silver Branch Mansion.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Please find out why the intruders are there. And if at all possible, I'd be grateful if you could ask them very nicely to leave...! (Earnest)

steps.name: Dreaming in the Cradle…
steps.objective: Talk to [Taffy] in the "Silver Branch Mansion", then defeat [Hero King Theseus] in the "Star Cradle" inside the mansion.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: So you were the ones making all that noise outside.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Beyond here lies the Star Cradle, the heart of Lilir, sacred and fertile land of the heavens.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: This place, where the spiritual veins of heaven and earth converge, is no place for uninvited guests such as you.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: You shall go no farther!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I am Theseus. Now, let the battle begin!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: It has been a long time since I enjoyed a fight this much! Haha... Delightful!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Come now, let us make it livelier still! Entertain me even more!

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: (An opening... Now!)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm?! You scoundrel!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ruzmen suddenly appears and rushes toward the Star's Heart, but Theseus blocks the way...!)

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Tch. No good, then.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: So you're the source of that foul presence I've been sensing! A thief after the power of star creation. Give up! I have no blind spots!

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: ...Tch. Don't get cocky, you bastard. I'll kill you!

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Damn it, if only I didn't have these restraints... Well, no sense dwelling on failure.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Hey, you little brats. Thanks for clearing the way. You made getting here a breeze. Hahaha...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ruzmen sneers with a mocking laugh...)

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: That doesn't settle what you owe me for earlier, though.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Watch your neck when you sleep, if you want to keep it.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: And you, big guy! I'll kill you someday too. Just you wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ruzmen escapes the cavern, moving with uncanny agility and astonishing speed.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: ...Hmm. What a strange fellow. Why does he radiate such menace?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: In any case... You don't seem to have come here with ill intent after all.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Let us hear your story. What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain Taffy's request and your conversation with Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm... I see. [They] would not have intended to worry the Star Dwarfs who live here.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Come this way. They should have returned by now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They?)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Oh my! We have guests?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hmm? Those faces seem familiar... Or is it simply that they're so utterly ordinary...?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: King of the Fairies, has all gone well?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh, great Hero King, my friend! You have my deepest thanks. Everything is going splendidly, thanks to you!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Now, one more hour... Wasn't that right, young witch?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is correct, King of the Fairies.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The barriers set up throughout Lilir are channeling its magic through the Star Cradle and into this [Star's Heart].

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The barriers will hold for about an hour. Within that time, you should obtain what you desire.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: ...Mhehehehehehehe!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ehehehe... I just can't stop smiling!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh, Titania, beautiful Titania! What a wonderful night! ♪

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: La-la-la, my handsome Oberon! A truly beautiful night! ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The oddly giddy fairy king and queen begin dancing a polka.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sweetness is so cloying that it hurts to watch...)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: You over there, with those faces that suggest you haven't a sweetheart—what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You suppress a surge of volcanic fury.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask what you want to know...)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh dear. Have we worried the Star Dwarfs?

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ah, we're sorry. Truly!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: We have every right to be here. When the Keeper of the Stars left the earthly world, we were asked to look after Lilir from time to time.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Once the Star Dwarfs know it's us here, they'll be reassured.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: We were in such a hurry that we didn't tell anyone. We've worried so many people... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: ...Hehe. Curious, are you?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Well... You see... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hahaha. How embarrassing!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: ...The truth is, we're expecting!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: We are, at last!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: After a thousand years, finally...!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Yes. What we've waited for through more than a thousand long years...

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: After a thousand years, we finally have heirs!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm. Wonderful news indeed. I am truly happy for you, King and Queen of the Fairies.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Congratulations.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You offer your congratulations...)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Hehehe, thank you!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: And so, you see, we need a special [star] for our princes and princesses.

choices.text: 3. What kind of star is about to be born?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: These children will one day rule the fairy realm. They will be born with power great enough to encompass the world, but destined to face an equally immense darkness.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: An ordinary blessing will not suffice. Their fate may one day determine the fate of the world itself.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: So, as their parents, we wish to give them the greatest blessing we can...!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: The new star born from the power gathered in the [Star's Heart] will become a mighty guardian star, shining brightly on our children's path.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Witch, where will the new star blessed by the starstone be born...? Hmm? The change has begun!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An auspicious light suddenly pours from the starstone.)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: ...At last, the star is about to be born! Where?

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Can you tell where, dear witch?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...It seems to be close to the sky above the barrier at Constellation Cliff.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Bathing in the light of their guardian star will be wonderful for the babies before they're born!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: What? Where did you hear such nonsense...?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Constellation Hill, then! Splendid! Titania! Let's go!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Oh, Oberon, honestly... You're impossible. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Dear witch, thank you for your help. I will keep my promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora bows silently.)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hahaha! Titania, my love, as radiant as the dew at dawn! Has there ever been a more blessed day?

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ohoho! Indeed, my dear Oberon!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hmm. So, stars being born and fading away in Lilir is perfectly natural.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: But sometimes, a very special star is needed.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: A star to light a dark place... A star to warm living things shivering in the cold... A star to protect someone...

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Then, just as the Keeper of the Stars once did, you come here to the Star Cradle and pray to that enormous starstone. A star is born to grant your wish.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: But we are not as powerful as the Keeper of the Stars, so this witch helped us gather Lilir's magic into the starstone.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hehehe... It won't be long now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The fairy king and queen disappear toward the cavern entrance, spinning and tap-dancing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The three left behind stand awkwardly, with nothing to do.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The [Star's Heart] chooses that moment to stop glowing, leaving the mood even emptier!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Theseus clears his throat.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Ahem. Well... As I said earlier, my name is Theseus. I happen to rule a certain small kingdom.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I am an old friend of the fairy king and queen... I came to this world briefly to help King Oberon.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: If you are curious how the royal couple and I came to know one another...

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: We shall save that story for another time, if fate allows.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: In any event, my work here seems to be done. I should be returning to my own world.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Little witch, thank you for helping my friends so well. Such an admirable young girl!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...As I have said several times, I am not as young as I look... But thank you, Hero King.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm. Give my regards to the fairy king and queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Hero King makes an intricate gesture, and a radiant doorway appears in midair.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I greatly enjoyed our battle. And please convey my apologies to the beings of this place for the disturbance.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hahaha! Farewell!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: He's gone, then. Such an important figure appearing out of nowhere put me on edge, but it came to nothing in the end...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Hero King disappears, leaving only Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm. Quiet at last.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Why are you staring? Is there something you want to say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask what you want to know...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm? I am Pandora. Mistress of Poe Mansion, the only witch in Jiendia. And... as you know, an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why are you interested in me? What more do you want to know?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well... I don't mind.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Hmm. You've noticed the contradiction, then?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well... Very well. I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm being awfully kind to people who tried to kill me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Agasura's contract. An omnipotent power that grants a single wish, whatever it may be.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: In return, the one who makes the wish loses something forever. And the Agasura... loses its life.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is the law.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yet I, who saved Levi's life, am still very much alive. Strange, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll tell you two things.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Poe Mansion... Long ago, its masters were Edgar the knight and Allan the mage. I hear they made a fine pair.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Allan was an intelligent, diligent man. In his old age, he attained greatness—enough to bend the world's laws a little with his mysterious magic...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is what Poe Mansion is. A place with the power to let someone dwell, for a while, beyond the laws of the world.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: By using that mansion's power and the secret arts of a witch, I managed to evade the law of the Agasura and remain alive.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But... things changed recently.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The law of the Agasura... The price it demands of us: sacrifice.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It no longer takes effect.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Agasura have gained the omnipotent power to grant wishes, and with it, the possibility of becoming living gods upon the earth.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...I don't know exactly why it happened... But one thing is certain.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: When that change occurred... the power felt everywhere in the world belonged to Choen, that foolish, pitiful girl.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hehehe... Well, it worked out nicely for me. Now I can leave the mansion and do as I please.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Levi? You want to know about our relationship?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Hmm.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Long ago, a knight came to Poe Mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: His name was Lian Arens. Yes, Levi's father.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi was only a baby, suffering from an incurable illness. Without help, he would soon have died.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Lian Arens staked his own life and wished for me to save his son. I granted that wish...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi Arens lived. In exchange, he lost his emotions.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You might wonder why Levi paid the price, rather than his father, who made the contract. But that would be a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Lian Arens paid for his wish with agony like hell itself. His son, whom he valued more than his own life, had lost his precious emotions...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is the Agasura's contract. Its terror lies in never knowing what price a wish will demand...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And, separately from the Agasura's contract, I came to possess both Lian's and Levi's souls. Father and son...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Not a particularly warm, affectionate relationship, is it? Hehehe...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But you, the anomalies and possibilities of this world, defeated me. And so Levi regained his freedom.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And... now he works for the royal family. He still visits me from time to time.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Just as he did when he was a child...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You want to know my purpose?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: My purpose...? I told you, didn't I? The fairy king and queen hired me to help them. That's all.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Well, yes. I do have a reason.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I need the magic of light that fills the fairy realm.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Its magic is deadly to powers such as my witchcraft.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I need that pure power, capable of dispersing even the oldest and most dangerous magic of the abyss.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Only with that power can I... free them... him...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi Arens? How did you get here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I followed the magic connecting us.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: When I concentrated, I could sense it, like a long, unbroken thread.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Impossible. A mere warrior, imitating the work of an accomplished mage...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Hmph. Levi Arens indeed. The finest knight in Elias, aren't you? ...Well? What do you want?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I came to escort you home, of course.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...You cannot survive outside the mansion, can you? Everyone there is worried. Please come back with me.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What? What do you...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm not going. Go home. I have things to do.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I cannot do that. ...I don't know what you're doing, but then I shall stay and help you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No. Go back! Now!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora...? What is happening? Please explain.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Persistent, aren't you? Enough!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ?! A return spell?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...Lady Pandora, what...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Gone, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora begins murmuring to herself.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Levi, this is too dangerous for you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I started this because there is something I want to give back to you. What sense would it make to drag you into danger yourself?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her words about giving something back linger in your mind.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Oh, we were talking, weren't we...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...In the end, what I want to find...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's... Levi's...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: His s-smile, and... l-l-l-love! ...Something like that.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Hmph! Laugh if you want. I'm serious.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I will give them back to him. Even if it means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora leaves the thought unfinished.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...The appointed night is drawing near. I'll be going. There is still much to prepare...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...A warning. You'd be wise not to meddle.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Stay out of [Walpurgis Night].

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Even you won't come away unscathed if you carelessly set foot in the witches' festival...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Farewell, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora leaves. Return to Taffy and explain what happened, leaving out the part about Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Adventurer, you're back! (Expectant)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Taffy what happened in the Star Cradle.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: I see. Leave the rest to me, a Star Knight! (Thoughtful)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that everything settled at the Star Cradle for now? I have a feeling I'll meet Pandora, Ruzmen, and Theseus again someday...)
